{"claims":[{"claim_text":"DSA was an early and strong supporter of Bernie Sanders in his campaign for the Democratic nomination for president.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"It is likely that DSA members hold a range of views on whether or not Bernie Sanders should have endorsed Heath Mello.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Some argue that Bernie Sanders should not endorse any candidate who does not have a strong track record supporting reproductive justice.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"If DSA does not denounce Bernie Sanders’ action, it is failing in its commitment to reproductive justice, according to some.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Others argue that electoral politics rarely involves supporting a 100% perfect candidate.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"There are good strategic reasons to support Heath Mello, namely to stop the election of a conservative anti-abortion, anti-choice candidate who brought in Wisconsin governor Scott Walker to campaign for her.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Heath Mello's opponent is a conservative anti-abortion, anti-choice candidate who brought in Wisconsin governor Scott Walker to campaign for her.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
